non_claims: not a statement that indexed zkrtp/streamfold payloads are correct

research_notes.note: PCD attaches proofs to data/messages so prescribed output properties can be checked.
Modern zkVM receipts separate public output/journal from opaque proof/seal; this lane mimics that separation without claiming zkVM soundness.

statement: For an extracted rev0853 overlay bundle, public verification can check that the overlay manifest describes the regular files, the overlay patch chain is continuous from rev0840 to rev0853, the first PROOFCORE lane files are present, the proof-signal role map was derived from the carried canonical index, and publication remains blocked pending rights decisions.
